name: browser/research
title: Research from several sources
summary: Answer a question from several sources: search with two or three queries, read the best pages, cite numbered sources.
when: Use when the answer needs current facts from the web and one search result is not enough.
steps: Rewrite the question as three short search phrases covering different angles and call multi_search with queries and max_results 6.
Pick three to five promising URLs from the ranked list, favouring official and dated pages, and call fetch_pages with those urls.
Re-read the numbered evidence pack and note the exact sentence behind each figure you plan to use, with its source number.
If two sources give different figures, call fetch_page on the stronger one and check which figure is newer and better sourced.
Drop any claim that no fetched passage supports, then call note action save with the question and the numbered source list.
If a fetch fails with a host or timeout error, say the page could not be read and use search snippets only, marked unverified.
Answer in plain sentences, cite each fact as [1] or [2] in order of first use, and list the URLs at the end.
next: The final answer must state the answer in plain sentences with numbered citations [1], [2] and the URL list below.
